cards.ex: We should hit the road early to avoid traffic.
cards.exUz: Trafikdan qochish uchun erta yo'lga tushishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Sayohatga yoki biror joyga ketishni boshlash.

cards.ex: I like to explore places that are off the beaten path.
cards.exUz: Men sayyohlar kam boradigan joylarni o'rganishni yoqtiraman.

cards.ex: I always try to travel light when I fly.
cards.exUz: Men doim uchayotganda yengil sayohat qilishga harakat qilaman.

cards.ex: I need to catch a flight to London tomorrow.
cards.exUz: Ertaga Londonga reyska ulgurishim kerak.

cards.ex: I've been on the move all day; I'm exhausted.
cards.exUz: Men butun kun harakatda bo'ldim; juda charchadim.
cards.uzDef: Doimiy harakatda bo'lish, bir joyda turmaslik.

cards.ex: It's easy to get around the city by bus.
cards.exUz: Shaharda avtobusda aylanib yurish oson.

cards.ex: We're planning a road trip across the country.
cards.exUz: Biz butun mamlakat bo'ylab avtosayohatni rejalashtiryapmiz.
cards.uzDef: Avtomobil bilan uzoq masofaga sayohat qilish.

cards.ex: We'll set off early in the morning.
cards.exUz: Ertalab erta yo'lga chiqamiz.

cards.ex: I have a three-hour layover in Chicago.
cards.exUz: Chikagoda uch soatlik o'tish vaqtim bor.
cards.uzDef: Sayohat davomida bir aeroportda kutish vaqti.

cards.ex: It's best to book your tickets in advance.
cards.exUz: Chiptalarni oldindan bron qilgan ma'qul.

cards.ex: I had to pay the full fare because I booked late.
cards.exUz: Men kech bron qilganim uchun to'liq narxni to'lashga majbur bo'ldim.
cards.uzDef: Chipta yoki xizmat uchun to'liq narx.

cards.ex: Just hop on the bus; it's leaving now.
cards.exUz: Shunchaki avtobusga sakrab chiqing; u hozir ketyapti.

cards.ex: Hop off at the next stop; it's near the museum.
cards.exUz: Keyingi bekatda sakrab tushing; u muzeyga yaqin.

cards.ex: We got a flat tire in the middle of nowhere.
cards.exUz: Biz hech kim yo'q joyda shinamiz yorilib qoldi.

cards.ex: I missed my connection because my flight was delayed.
cards.exUz: Reysim kechiktirilgani sababli o'tish reysini o'tkazib yubordim.
cards.uzDef: Bir reysdan ikkinchisiga o'tish vaqtida kechikish.

cards.ex: I hate long haul flights; they're so tiring.
cards.exUz: Men uzoq reyslardan nafratlanaman; ular juda charchatadi.

cards.ex: I need to pack a suitcase for my trip tomorrow.
cards.exUz: Ertangi sayohatim uchun chamadon yig'ishim kerak.
cards.uzDef: Sayohat uchun kerakli narsalarni chamadonga solish.

cards.ex: We booked our trip through a travel agency.
cards.exUz: Biz sayohatimizni sayyohlik agentligi orqali bron qildik.
cards.uzDef: Sayohatlarni tashkil etish bilan shug'ullanuvchi kompaniya.

cards.ex: Our tour guide was very knowledgeable about the city.
cards.exUz: Bizning gid shaharni juda yaxshi bilardi.

cards.ex: We need to check in at the hotel.
cards.exUz: Biz mehmonxonada ro'yxatdan o'tishimiz kerak.

cards.ex: We have to check out by noon.
cards.exUz: Biz tushgacha chiqishimiz kerak.

cards.ex: It's important to have travel insurance when you travel abroad.
cards.exUz: Chet elga sayohat qilganda sayohat sug'urtasiga ega bo'lish muhim.
cards.uzDef: Sayohat davomida yuzaga kelishi mumkin bo'lgan xatarlardan himoya.

cards.ex: We spent the afternoon just wandering around the old town.
cards.exUz: Biz tushdan keyin shunchaki eski shaharda aylanib yurib o'tkazdik.

cards.ex: That restaurant is a tourist trap; the food is terrible and overpriced.
cards.exUz: Bu restoran sayyohlar tuzog'i; ovqatlari juda yomon va narxi baland.
cards.uzDef: Narxi baland, sifati past joylar sayyohlar uchun.

cards.ex: I get seasick easily, so I avoid boats.
cards.exUz: Men osonlik bilan dengiz kasalligiga chalinaman, shuning uchun qayiqdan qochaman.
cards.uzDef: Kema yoki qayiqda sayohat qilganda ko'ngil aynishi.

cards.ex: I'm taking the red-eye flight to New York.
cards.exUz: Men Nyu-Yorkga tungi reys bilan uchayapman.
cards.uzDef: Kechasi uchadigan va erta tongda yetib boradigan reys.

cards.ex: Let's take the scenic route; it's more beautiful.
cards.exUz: Keling, manzarali yo'ldan boramiz; u juda chiroyli.

cards.ex: He decided to hitchhike across Europe.
cards.exUz: U Yevropa bo'ylab qo'l ko'tarib to'xtatishga qaror qildi.

cards.ex: We need a weekend getaway to the beach.
cards.exUz: Bizga dam olish kunlari plyajga qochish kerak.
cards.uzDef: Oddiy hayotdan qisqa muddatga dam olish.

cards.ex: I've got the travel bug; I want to go somewhere new.
cards.exUz: Menda sayohat ishtiyoqi bor; men yangi joyga borishni xohlayman.
